mechanism: Bumetanide-induced ototoxicity and renal dysfunction may be potentiated by ethambutol, which also carries ototoxic and nephrotoxic risks, particularly at higher doses or with renal impairment.
action: Monitor renal function, audiometry, and uric acid levels; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative TB regimens if possible; assess ethambutol dose appropriateness based on renal function and visual acuity.
